title: Beyond the Best Guess: Improving LLM Solution Coverage with Evolution Strategies
abstract: arXiv:2608.12679v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in discovery domains such as math and science. The usual approach is to present the problem to the model and use its answer as the proposed solution. However, beyond this best guess, discovery can be enhanced by increasing test-time compute. In a process called pass@k, the model is allowed to explore the solution space and generate diverse candidate solutions. Unfortunately, the standard approach to post-training LLMs through Reinforcement Learning (RL) may limit pass@k: the model's output distribution narrows around high-reward outputs, causing the solution coverage to collapse. The alternative is to use Evolution Strategies (ES), a population-based, gradient-free post-training method that optimizes directly in weight space through random perturbations. translated_title: 超越最佳猜测：利用进化策略提升大语言模型解决方案覆盖范围
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12679v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地部署在数学和科学等发现领域。通常的方法是将问题呈现给模型，并使用其答案作为提出的解决方案。然而，超越这一最佳猜测，可以通过增加测试时计算来增强发现能力。在一个称为pass@k的过程中，模型被允许探索解决方案空间并生成多样化的候选解决方案。不幸的是，通过强化学习（RL）对LLMs进行后训练的标准方法可能限制pass@k：模型的输出分布会围绕高奖励输出变窄，导致解决方案覆盖范围崩溃。替代方案是使用进化策略（ES），这是一种基于种群、无梯度的后训练方法，通过随机扰动直接在权重空间中优化。正如本文所示，ES相比RL实现了持续更高的pass@k，并产生更广泛的输出分布，具有更大的解决方案多样性。
tldr: 本文提出使用进化策略替代强化学习进行大语言模型后训练，显著提升pass@k指标，避免解决方案覆盖范围崩溃，从而增强模型在发现任务中的探索能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using Evolution Strategies instead of Reinforcement Learning for post-training LLMs, significantly improving pass@k metrics and preventing solution coverage collapse, thereby enhancing exploration in discovery tasks.
